objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix with consecutive number identifying the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version identifier incremented on each new editing version.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from valid-from plus validity period.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Configurable period for validity extension check (default 3 years).

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification category of a document determining its level, template availability, abbreviation, and configurable validity and archive periods.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Language-independent abbreviation code for the document type.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (e.g., Level 2 for guidelines, Level 4 for work instructions).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment mirroring the main document release process.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version identifier of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object linked to a document that is not subject to the main document release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional information has been directly published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for changing an existing released document, managed independently of the document version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, triggering a workflow to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggering an override (out-of-force) workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restricted to the Business Admin group.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user assigned as the primary responsible creator and editor of a document, automatically set upon document creation.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user granted additional personal change rights on a document who can also initiate the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user responsible for checking document content according to technical and/or formal aspects during the review workflow step.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user responsible for final approval and release of a document, deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user who translates released document content into another language; cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user who can only view approved and released documents to which they are authorized.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined authorization group used to assign read or change rights to a set of users for documents.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name identifying the user group (e.g., Reader - Document Management, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document controlling email notification, acknowledgement requests, and dashboard visibility upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance managing approval steps such as creator sign-off, review, and release with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow process (e.g., release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature captured from workflow participants at each workflow step, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was applied.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step at which the signature was provided (creator, review, release).

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a reader that they have taken note of a released document version, tracked per person.

attributes.name: confirmed
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed by the recipient.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference data such as IT applications, organizational units, risks, or relevant companies that can be linked to documents.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document information object is attached in the system with selection of a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is opened and edited via the local Office editing client.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator - Review - Release) is started by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review step positively or negatively with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Whether the review was approved or rejected.

evts.name: complete_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release step positively or negatively with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Whether the release was approved or rejected.

evts.name: reject_in_workflow
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing cancellation for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is formally released and automatically published, becoming visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created, retaining data from the previous version.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon the next main document version release.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for a released document by any user with author rights, without affecting document content or version.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of a change proposal, triggering notification to the proposal creator.

evts.name: generate_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically generates a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid-until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed through a workflow, resulting in extended validity, revision, or override.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Result of the validity extension check (extended, revision needed, or override).

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is extended by the configured period and the validity extension request is deleted.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A request to invalidate a document is created by a user with write access.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow (by releaser alone or through initiator-reviewer-releaser steps).

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; the last released version is archived and all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by a Business Admin group member for an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow-supported task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version undergoes review and release workflow and becomes visible to readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or distribution events.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Category of notification (e.g., workflow task, validity extension info, change proposal, acknowledgement).

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after the archive duration has expired.

o2o.description: Each document belongs to exactly one document type that determines its level and configuration.
Each document type can have one or more associated templates for creating new documents.
An attachment is a controlled sub-document linked to a main document and released with it.
Additional information is supplementary content linked to a document without affecting its release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within that document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request references the specific invalidated document to be reactivated.
Documents can be linked to master data such as IT applications, organizational units, and risks.
Documents can reference other documents through the references attribute.
A distribution list is maintained per document controlling notification and acknowledgement recipients.
A distribution list contains user groups whose members receive distribution notifications and dashboard access.
User groups can have subgroups assigned (e.g., location-specific subgroups under reader groups).

o2e.description: A document is the primary object created during the create document event.
A document type is selected when creating a new document.
A template may be selected from the document type when creating a new document.
The creator of a document is automatically set as the author.
Document properties and metadata are maintained on the document.
The document content is edited.
The document is automatically converted to PDF after saving.
The release workflow is initiated for a specific document.
The author or co-author initiates the release workflow.
A co-author can initiate the release workflow.
A workflow instance is created when the release process is initiated.
The registered author signs the creator step.
An electronic signature is captured during the creator step.
The sign creator step is a task within the release workflow.
A reviewer completes the review step.
An electronic signature is captured during the review step.
The review step is a task within the release workflow.
A releaser completes the release step.
An electronic signature is captured during the release step.
The release step is a task within the release workflow.
A reviewer may reject the document during review.
A releaser may reject the document during release.
The rejection cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.
The document is released and published.
A new editing version is created for the document.
An attachment is added to a document.
Adding an attachment triggers a new version of the main document.
An existing attachment is modified.
Modifying an attachment triggers a new version of the main document.
An attachment is marked for archiving.
Archiving an attachment is associated with the main document lifecycle.
An additional info object is added.
Additional info is added to a specific document.
An additional info object is deleted.
Additional info is deleted from a specific document.
A change proposal object is created.
The change proposal is created for a specific document.
Any user with author rights can create a change proposal.
The change proposal is scheduled for implementation.
Scheduling creates a new version of the associated document.
The change proposal is marked as completed.
The author documents completion of the change proposal.
A validity extension request is generated by the system.
The request is generated for a specific document approaching validity expiry.
The validity extension request is processed through the workflow.
The releaser processes the validity extension check.
Reviewers may participate in the validity extension process depending on configuration.
Authors may participate in the validity extension process depending on configuration.
The document validity period is extended.
The validity extension request is deleted upon successful extension.
Attachments to the document are also given the same extended validity.
An override request is created.
The override request is associated with the document to be invalidated.
The override request is processed through the workflow.
The releaser processes the override request.
Reviewers may participate in the override process depending on configuration.
The document is declared out of force and archived.
Attachments are also invalidated and archived with the document.
The override request is retained for documentation after out-of-force declaration.
A reactivation request is created.
The reactivation request references the invalidated document.
The document is reactivated with a new version.
The reactivation request drives the reactivation process.
Archived attachments are reactivated along with the document.
The distribution list determines recipients of email notifications.
The released document version triggers email distribution.
The distribution list determines recipients of acknowledgement requests.
The released document version triggers acknowledgement distribution.
An acknowledgement is confirmed by the reader.
A reader confirms acknowledgement of the document.
The acknowledgement relates to a specific document version.
A translator performs the translation.
The released document content is translated.
The translated version of the document undergoes review and release.
A reviewer checks the translated version.
A releaser approves the translated version.
Email notifications are sent regarding events related to a document.
The document is physically deleted after archive duration expires.
